# UX Engineering Instructions

Apply these rules whenever making UX decisions or interaction-related code/content changes.

## Scope
- Navigation and information architecture
- Content flow and task clarity
- Accessibility and interaction behavior
- Form and conversion-path usability

## Rules
- Optimize for clear user tasks and reduced friction.
- Prefer simple interaction patterns already supported by the theme.
- Keep labels and page structure explicit and predictable.
- Avoid unnecessary new components or complex interaction models.
- Use accessibility-friendly semantics whenever templates are touched.

## Quality checks
- Validate main user paths are easy to understand.
- Confirm navigation labels and CTAs are action-oriented.
- Ensure keyboard and screen-reader behavior is not regressed.
